label: CCDC6::RET

sections.text: CCDC6 encodes a coiled-coil protein involved in DNA-damage signaling.
RET encodes a receptor tyrosine kinase activated by GDNF-family ligands and their coreceptors.

The fusion joins an amino-terminal oligomerization region to the RET tyrosine-kinase domain, enabling ligand-independent signaling. CCDC6::RET is a recurrent activating fusion in papillary thyroid carcinoma and also occurs in lung adenocarcinoma.

Selpercatinib is US-approved for adults with locally advanced or metastatic RET-fusion-positive NSCLC. From age 2 years, separate indications cover advanced RET-fusion-positive thyroid cancer requiring systemic therapy and radioactive-iodine-refractory disease when appropriate, and other advanced RET-fusion-positive solid tumors after prior treatment or without satisfactory alternatives.
